sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin, and I'm Mark Ronson, and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth into this like
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在黑胶唱片时代去夜店当DJ的时候，你每天晚上都要带上300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，然后把DJ台变成一个

sentences.en: living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 充满活力的快闪博物馆，里面摆满了50年前的精美艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, Obama and Trump.
sentences.zh: 今天的话题是奥巴马和特朗普。

sentences.en: Two newly revealed stories about the transition of power from one president to the next.
sentences.zh: 关于权力从一位总统交接给下一位总统的两个新披露的故事。

sentences.en: One is a warning.
sentences.zh: 一个是警告。

sentences.en: What Barack Obama told Donald Trump could be the biggest threat he'd inherit as president.
sentences.zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马告诉唐纳德·特朗普的内容，可能是他作为总统将要继承的最大威胁。

sentences.en: The other is an accusation.
sentences.zh: 另一个是指控。

sentences.en: President Trump is claiming, without evidence, that Obama wiretapped his communications during the campaign.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统声称，奥巴马在竞选期间窃听了他的通讯，但并未提供证据。

sentences.en: It's Monday, March 6.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月6日，星期一。

sentences.en: Where did the orders come from to intercept these phone calls, to record these phone calls?
sentences.zh: 拦截这些电话、录下这些通话的命令究竟来自何处？

sentences.en: How many more phone calls involving Michael Flynn and other would-be administration officials were intercepted and recorded?
sentences.zh: 还有多少涉及迈克尔·弗林和其他准政府官员的电话被拦截和录音了？

sentences.en: Were the president of the United States, the now president of the United States, Donald Trump, were his phone calls intercepted and recorded?
sentences.zh: 美国总统，也就是现任美国总统唐纳德·特朗普，他的电话是否也被拦截和录音了？

sentences.en: Those were the questions that Mark Levin, a popular talk radio show host, posed to his listeners last Thursday.
sentences.zh: 这些就是广受欢迎的谈话广播节目主持人马克·莱文上周四向听众提出的问题。

sentences.en: He was talking about the intercepted phone calls that led to the resignation of Trump's national security advisor, Michael Flynn.
sentences.zh: 他谈论的是导致特朗普的国家安全顾问迈克尔·弗林辞职的那些被拦截的电话。

sentences.en: And then Levin made a case.
sentences.zh: 然后，莱文提出了一个论点。

sentences.en: There is a much bigger scandal here.
sentences.zh: 这里面有一个更大的丑闻。

sentences.en: We have a prior administration, Barack Obama and his surrogates, who were supporting Hillary
sentences.zh: 我们有一届前任政府，巴拉克·奥巴马和他的代理人，他们支持希拉里·

sentences.en: Clinton and their party, the Democrat Party, who were using the instrumentalities of the federal government to surveil members of the Trump campaign and to put that information
sentences.zh: 克林顿和他们的政党——民主党，他们利用联邦政府的工具来监视特朗普竞选团队的成员，并将这些信息

sentences.en: out in the public.
sentences.zh: 公之于众。

sentences.en: Those are police state tactics.
sentences.zh: 这些是警察国家的手段。

sentences.en: Nothing General Flynn did, nothing General Sessions has done, are even in the same category as that.
sentences.zh: 弗林将军所做的任何事，塞申斯将军所做的任何事，都根本无法与此相提并论。

sentences.en: That was on Thursday night, March 2nd.
sentences.zh: 那是3月2日星期四晚上的事。

sentences.en: On Friday morning, Breitbart News published a story.
sentences.zh: 周五早上，布赖特巴特新闻网发表了一篇报道。

sentences.en: Obama's actions, Breitbart said, rather than conspiracy theories about alleged Russian interference
sentences.zh: 布赖特巴特称，奥巴马的行为，而不是关于所谓俄罗斯干预

sentences.en: in the presidential election, should be the target of congressional investigation.
sentences.zh: 总统选举的阴谋论，才应该是国会调查的目标。

sentences.en: The Breitbart story specifically referenced Mark Levin's radio show.
sentences.zh: 这篇布赖特巴特的报道特别提到了马克·莱文的广播节目。

sentences.en: The day after that, Saturday morning, at 6.36 a.m., Donald Trump sent out a tweet from
sentences.zh: 第二天，也就是周六早上6点36分，唐纳德·特朗普从

sentences.en: Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 海湖庄园发了一条推文。

sentences.en: Terrible, he wrote.
sentences.zh: 太可怕了，他写道。

sentences.en: Just found out that Obama had my wires tapped in Trump Tower just before the victory.
sentences.zh: 刚发现奥巴马在胜选前夕窃听了我在特朗普大厦的电话。

sentences.en: Nothing found.
sentences.zh: 什么也没查到。

sentences.en: This is McCarthyism.
sentences.zh: 这是麦卡锡主义。

sentences.en: Trump offered no proof of his claim and didn't say who it was he'd just found out from.
sentences.zh: 特朗普没有为他的指控提供任何证据，也没有说明他是从谁那里刚得知的消息。

sentences.en: But here's what we do know.
sentences.zh: 但我们知道的是这些。

sentences.en: Top aides to President Trump had read the story from Breitbart and circulated it around the White House.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统的高级助手们读到了布赖特巴特的报道，并在白宫内部进行了传阅。

sentences.en: On Sunday morning, three days after Mark Levin's original radio broadcast, President Trump demanded that Congress investigate his claim.
sentences.zh: 周日早上，也就是马克·莱文最初的广播节目播出三天后，特朗普总统要求国会调查他的指控。

sentences.en: Hours later...
sentences.zh: 几小时后……

sentences.en: I will say that for the part of the national security apparatus that I oversaw as DNI, there
sentences.zh: 我要说的是，对于我担任国家情报总监期间所监管的国家安全机构部分，

sentences.en: was no such wiretap activity mounted against the president-elect at the time or as a candidate or against his campaign.
sentences.zh: 当时并没有针对候任总统、候选人或其竞选团队进行过此类窃听活动。

sentences.en: James Clapper, who has served as the director of national intelligence for the past six years, went on Meet the Press, where Chuck Todd asked him.
sentences.zh: 过去六年一直担任国家情报总监的詹姆斯·克拉珀参加了《会见新闻界》节目，查克·托德问了他。

sentences.en: The FBI, for instance, had a FISA court order of some sort for a surveillance.
sentences.zh: 例如，联邦调查局是否获得了某种用于监视的外国情报监视法庭令？

sentences.en: Would that be information you would know or not know?
sentences.zh: 这是你会知道还是不知道的信息？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You would be told this?
sentences.zh: 你会收到通知吗？

sentences.en: I would know that.
sentences.zh: 我会知道的。

sentences.en: If there was a FISA court order on something like this?
sentences.zh: 如果针对这种事情有外国情报监视法庭令的话？

sentences.en: Something like this, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 像这样的事情，绝对会。

sentences.en: And at this point, you can't confirm or deny whether that exists?
sentences.zh: 那么在这一点上，你无法确认或否认它是否存在？

sentences.en: I can deny it.
sentences.zh: 我可以否认。

sentences.en: There is no FISA court order?
sentences.zh: 不存在外国情报监视法庭令？

sentences.en: Not to my knowledge.
sentences.zh: 据我所知没有。

sentences.en: Of anything at Trump Tower?
sentences.zh: 针对特朗普大厦的任何东西都没有？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Well, that's an important revelation at this point.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这在目前是一个重要的披露。

sentences.en: Inside the government, doubts about Trump's claims are mounting.
sentences.zh: 在政府内部，对特朗普指控的怀疑正在增加。

sentences.en: The Times on Sunday reported that FBI Director James Comey had asked the Justice Department
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》周日报道称，联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米已要求司法部

sentences.en: to publicly reject Trump's claim because he believes it falsely insinuates that the FBI broke the law.
sentences.zh: 公开反驳特朗普的说法，因为他认为这虚假地暗示了联邦调查局违法。

sentences.en: It's an extraordinary request by the FBI to rebuke the sitting President of the United States.
sentences.zh: 这是联邦调查局对在任美国总统发出的非同寻常的斥责请求。

sentences.en: The Justice Department, which oversees the FBI, has not publicly responded to Comey's request as of Sunday night.
sentences.zh: 截至周日晚间，监管联邦调查局的司法部尚未公开回应科米的请求。

sentences.en: The last time that President Trump demanded a federal investigation like this was back in late January.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统上一次要求进行此类联邦调查是在1月底。

sentences.en: Does the president believe that millions voted illegally in this election?
sentences.zh: 总统是否相信这次选举中有数百万人非法投票？

sentences.en: And what evidence do you have of widespread voter fraud in this election, if that's the case?
sentences.zh: 如果确实如此，你有什么证据证明这次选举中存在广泛的选民欺诈？

sentences.en: The president does believe that.
sentences.zh: 总统确实相信这一点。

sentences.en: He has stated that before.
sentences.zh: 他之前已经陈述过了。

sentences.en: I think he stated his concerns of voter fraud and people voting illegally during the campaign.
sentences.zh: 我想他在竞选期间就表达过对选民欺诈和非法投票的担忧。

sentences.en: And he continues to maintain that belief based on studies and evidence that people have presented to him.
sentences.zh: 他根据别人向他提供的研究和证据，继续坚持这一信念。

sentences.en: Back then, Trump claimed again on Twitter, and without citing any sources, that 3 to 5 million people had voted illegally on Election Day,
sentences.zh: 当时，特朗普再次在推特上声称，在没有引用任何来源的情况下，有300万到500万人非法投票，

sentences.en: depriving him of a victory in the popular vote.
sentences.zh: 这剥夺了他普选票的胜利。

sentences.en: So far, no such investigation has been launched, and no evidence of widespread voter fraud has materialized.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，还没有启动此类调查，也没有出现广泛选民欺诈的证据。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs, in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you,
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在黑胶唱片时代去夜店当DJ的时候，你每天晚上都要带上300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 然后把DJ台变成一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，里面摆满了50年前的精美艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: Well, I just had the opportunity to have an excellent conversation with President-elect Trump.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我刚刚有机会与候任总统特朗普进行了一次出色的交谈。

sentences.en: It was wide-ranging.
sentences.zh: 谈话内容非常广泛。

sentences.en: We talked about foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 我们谈到了外交政策。

sentences.en: We talked about domestic policy.
sentences.zh: 我们谈到了国内政策。

sentences.en: And as I said last night, my number one priority in the coming two months is to try to facilitate a transition that ensures our president-elect is successful.
sentences.zh: 正如我昨晚所说，我未来两个月的第一要务是努力促进平稳过渡，确保我们的候任总统取得成功。

sentences.en: In the days after the 2016 election, the president sat down for a series of conversations with the president-elect who would soon replace him.
sentences.zh: 2016年大选后的几天里，总统与即将接替他的候任总统进行了一系列对话。

sentences.en: Well, thank you very much, President Obama.
sentences.zh: 嗯，非常感谢你，奥巴马总统。

sentences.en: This was a meeting that was going to last for maybe 10 or 15 minutes, and we were just going to get to know each other.
sentences.zh: 这次会议本来预计只会持续10到15分钟，我们只是想互相认识一下。

sentences.en: We had never met each other.
sentences.zh: 我们之前从未见过面。

sentences.en: I have great respect.
sentences.zh: 我非常尊重他。

sentences.en: The meeting lasted for almost an hour and a half.
sentences.zh: 会议持续了近一个半小时。

sentences.en: And it could have, as far as I'm concerned, it could have gone on for a lot longer.
sentences.zh: 就我而言，它本可以持续更长时间。

sentences.en: We now know that of the many things the two men discussed, one of them was a threat.
sentences.zh: 我们现在知道，两人讨论的许多事情中，其中一件是关于威胁的。

sentences.en: A threat that Obama told Trump was perhaps the single biggest facing the Trump presidency from its first day.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马告诉特朗普，这可能是特朗普总统任期从第一天起就面临的最大威胁。

sentences.en: We discussed a lot of different situations, some wonderful and some difficulties.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论了许多不同的情况，有些很美好，有些则很困难。

sentences.en: And Trump learned of a program, unknown to all but a handful of Americans, that is quietly working to sabotage that threat.
sentences.zh: 特朗普了解到了一项除了少数美国人外鲜为人知的计划，该计划正在悄悄地致力于破坏这一威胁。

sentences.en: Bill, thank you for being here in the studio.
sentences.zh: 比尔，谢谢你来到演播室。

sentences.en: David, thank you for coming on from Washington.
sentences.zh: 大卫，谢谢你从华盛顿连线。

sentences.en: A pleasure.
sentences.zh: 我的荣幸。

sentences.en: Great to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: David Sanger and William Broad have reported together on nuclear arms and missile defense for decades.
sentences.zh: 大卫·桑格和威廉·布罗德几十年来一直共同报道核武器和导弹防御问题。

sentences.en: David, what did President Obama say to President-elect Donald Trump in that conversation?
sentences.zh: 大卫，奥巴马总统在那次谈话中对候任总统唐纳德·特朗普说了什么？

sentences.en: From the accounts that have dribbled out since, and they have only dribbled out, and from President Trump's statement that he was told about one really big problem,
sentences.zh: 从那之后零星传出的消息来看——确实只是零星传出——以及特朗普总统关于他被告知了一个非常大的问题的声明，

sentences.en: it's become clear that that problem was North Korea.
sentences.zh: 很明显，那个问题就是朝鲜。

sentences.en: Now to North Korea, a nation that has nuclear weapons and is tonight threatening to use them against the United States.
sentences.zh: 现在转向朝鲜，这个国家拥有核武器，并且今晚威胁要对美国使用它们。

sentences.en: Listen to this, a Fox News alert now.
sentences.zh: 听听这个，来自福克斯新闻的紧急快讯。

sentences.en: North Korea intensifying its show of force overnight.
sentences.zh: 朝鲜连夜加强了武力展示。

sentences.en: A first strike nuclear attack with a vow to engulf Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 誓言要发动首次核打击，将华盛顿特区

sentences.en: in a sea of fire.
sentences.zh: 淹没在火海之中。

sentences.en: The latest blast so strong, it triggered a 5.3 magnitude earthquake.
sentences.zh: 最近的一次爆炸威力巨大，引发了5.3级地震。

sentences.en: And in fact, President Obama and his national security team were so concerned about what could
sentences.zh: 事实上，奥巴马总统和他的国家安全团队非常担心在过渡期间

sentences.en: happen during the transition with North Korea that they had prepared a sort of playbook of
sentences.zh: 朝鲜可能会发生什么，以至于他们准备了一份“剧本”，

sentences.en: what they could do and how they might react if the North Koreans test launched an intercontinental ballistic missile right around the time of the inauguration.
sentences.zh: 如果朝鲜人在就职典礼前后试射洲际弹道导弹，他们可以采取什么行动以及如何应对。

sentences.en: In fact, the first deputies meeting of the National Security Council, the first week of the Trump administration, was on North Korea.
sentences.zh: 事实上，特朗普政府第一周的国家安全委员会首次副手会议，讨论的就是朝鲜问题。

sentences.en: That's kind of mind-blowing about the threat of this happening during the inauguration.
sentences.zh: 在就职典礼期间发生这种威胁，这简直令人震惊。

sentences.en: But beyond that, this has to come as an incredible surprise to not just Donald Trump, but to our listeners, that of all the threats facing the United States,
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，这不仅对唐纳德·特朗普，对我们的听众来说，也一定是一个令人难以置信的惊喜：在所有威胁美国的问题中，

sentences.en: in President Obama's mind, it is North Korea.
sentences.zh: 在奥巴马总统看来，竟然是朝鲜。

sentences.en: I think it comes as a surprise, Michael, because President Trump, in the run-up to taking office, had talked about ISIS and terrorism as the number one threat.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我认为这确实令人惊讶，因为特朗普总统在上任前，一直把“伊斯兰国”和恐怖主义视为头号威胁。

sentences.en: We take out ISIS, number one.
sentences.zh: 我们要消灭“伊斯兰国”，这是第一位的。

sentences.en: We take out ISIS.
sentences.zh: 我们要消灭“伊斯兰国”。

sentences.en: And had complained about the Iran deal.
sentences.zh: 而且他一直抱怨伊朗协议。

sentences.en: This is one of the worst deals ever made by any country in history.
sentences.zh: 这是历史上任何国家达成的最糟糕的协议之一。

sentences.en: The deal with Iran will lead to nuclear probleMs.
sentences.zh: 与伊朗的协议将导致核问题。

sentences.en: All they have to do is sit back 10 years.
sentences.zh: 他们所要做的就是坐等10年。

sentences.en: But let's face it, ISIS can't strike the United States in a large way.
sentences.zh: 但让我们面对现实吧，“伊斯兰国”无法对美国进行大规模打击。

sentences.en: And Iran, whatever you think of the Iran deal, is without nuclear materials of a significant nature for at least the next 10 to 15 years.
sentences.zh: 而伊朗，无论你如何看待伊朗协议，在未来至少10到15年内，它都没有重要的核材料。

sentences.en: What did that leave President Obama?
sentences.zh: 那奥巴马总统还剩下什么担心呢？

sentences.en: It left him worried that the North Korean threat, the combination of a country that has
sentences.zh: 他担心的是朝鲜的威胁，这是一个国家的组合，它

sentences.en: been working on nuclear weapons, but had stepped up its testing program and was now successfully
sentences.zh: 一直在研究核武器，但加强了测试计划，现在已经成功

sentences.en: detonating weapons that had a yield larger than what destroyed Hiroshima, and that had been accelerating its missile program quite rapidly.
sentences.zh: 引爆了当量超过摧毁广岛的那种武器，而且其导弹计划一直在迅速加速。

sentences.en: One of the things, Michael, that gave all the techie people in the government a lot of jitters, a lot of jitters, is that the North Koreans had benefited enormously from waves of
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，让政府里所有技术人员感到非常紧张的一件事是，朝鲜从

sentences.en: Russian missile designers after the Cold War.
sentences.zh: 冷战后的俄罗斯导弹设计师浪潮中获益匪浅。

sentences.en: And why were the Russians coming to North Korea?
sentences.zh: 为什么俄罗斯人会去朝鲜？
